summary: Absent-teacher reminder (تنبيه الأستاذ الغائب) P1 feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest pass (manual POST 200 -> notification with exact title + message to teacher user, absence_reminders doc, GET status, 2nd POST 409 incl. previous sent_at; non-absent 409; pending/approved justification 409; invalid/missing id 404; teacher 403; unauthenticated 401/403; cron run: missing/wrong/no-Bearer -> 401, +13h sent (kind=auto), +5h/+80h/+20h-with-pending not sent, 2nd run sent=0). Frontend: /take-attendance on lecture 6adf07d96ca65fb754750453 -> button shown, confirm dialog with message preview, after confirm green badge 'تم التنبيه 2026-10-26 10:59 (يدوي)', persists after reload; lecture status stays 'absent', status_override intact, attendance records unchanged (0 before/0 after). /report-teacher-attendance (today) by-lecture & by-teacher expanded views render both button and sent badge correctly. /course-lectures shows 7 'تنبيه الأستاذ' buttons beside التفاصيل/إعادة الجدولة; full click-through on one sent OK and badge replaced button. Teacher 222222 (logged in via x-platform: android header since teachers are blocked from web login) sees no reminder button on take-attendance or course-lectures. Feature is functional; several logic/UX issues found, listed below.

minor.issue: Doesn't check the 72h justification window. An admin can send a manual reminder for an old absent lecture (tested: lecture from 2026-04-13), and the message asks the teacher to submit an excuse 'before 2026-04-16', a deadline that has already passed. Either reject with 409 when now > end+72h, or change the wording.

There is no unique index on lecture_id; the only index is _id. The duplicate check is find_one followed by insert_one, so two concurrent requests (double click, or a manual send racing the cron) can both pass the check and send two notifications. Add create_index('lecture_id', unique=True) and catch DuplicateKeyError -> 409.

If the teacher record has no user_id, nothing is sent (no notification or push), but a reminder doc is still saved and the API returns ok:true, so the UI shows 'تم التنبيه' even though nobody received it. Return a 409/422 instead, or record delivered:false.

Side effect beyond the spec: step 1 changes every past 'scheduled' lecture in the database to 'absent'. This is a global data change triggered by a notification cron. It is also synchronous, even though the code comment says the endpoint should ack immediately and run in the background, and it uses to_list(5000) twice, so it can be slow or silently truncate on a large DB. Confirm the status mutation is intended.
There is no permission check: any authenticated user can read the reminder status of any lecture. This is low risk.

ui_bugs.issue: The deadline in the confirm dialog is computed with new Date(local) followed by toISOString(), which is UTC. For a browser in Yemen (UTC+3) the preview shows a deadline 3h earlier than the one actually sent (verified: TZ=Asia/Aden preview '2026-10-29 06:57' vs backend message '2026-10-29 09:57'). It only matched in the test because the test browser runs in UTC. Format the date manually without converting to UTC, or have the backend return the exact message (e.g. a preview field in the GET status response).

integration_issues.flow: Report teacher attribution vs reminder recipient
integration_issues.issue: In /report-teacher-attendance, lecture 6adf07d96ca65fb754750453 is listed under the course teacher 'أستاذ اختبار 180156' (course.teacher_id 698f6714...). The reminder is sent to the lecture's own teacher_id, زين سالم (698ad3da...). So an admin clicks 'تنبيه الأستاذ' on one teacher's row and a different teacher receives it. The report and the reminder should use the same teacher (lecture.teacher_id || course.teacher_id).

Each AbsenceReminderButton makes 2 requests on mount (GET reminder status + GET /absence-justifications/meta). A report with N absent lectures triggers 2N requests. Batch the status into the report payload, and fetch meta once.

action_items: Fix the timezone bug in the AbsenceReminderButton preview deadline (toISOString gives UTC). Better: have the backend return the exact message text.
Make the report's teacher attribution and the reminder recipient consistent (lecture.teacher_id vs course.teacher_id).
Add a unique index on absence_reminders.lecture_id and handle DuplicateKeyError -> 409.
Decide whether a manual reminder past the 72h window should be blocked; the message currently quotes a deadline that has passed.
Don't report success (ok:true / sent badge) when the teacher has no user account and no notification was delivered.
Review whether the cron should change scheduled lectures to absent across the whole DB, and drop the misleading 'ack immediately' comment or run the work in the background.
critical_code_review_comments: absence_reminders.py: the duplicate check is a find_one then insert_one, which is not atomic (no unique index).
absence_reminders.py: the manual endpoint ignores JUSTIFY_WINDOW_HOURS.
AbsenceReminderButton.tsx: the message text is duplicated on the client (it is a DRY copy of the backend build_message), which is how the timezone drift happened.
course-lectures.tsx uses `user?.role === 'admin' || hasPermission(...)`, while report and take-attendance use hasPermission only. Admin works in all three, but the checks are inconsistent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows functional; 1 preview timezone bug + 1 teacher attribution mismatch

seed_data_creation: The pytest suite creates temporary lectures (room TEST_AR, group TEST_AR_*) and deletes them, along with their reminders, notifications and justifications, on teardown. A temporary UI lecture 6adf089d303f617e27e48172 was deleted, and the UI test reminder on real lecture 69ce7a3de34059a832583800 was removed. The reminder on test lecture 6adf07d96ca65fb754750453 (manual, 2026-10-26T10:59) was KEPT, so that lecture now shows as sent.

Lecture 6adf07d96ca65fb754750453 already has a manual reminder. /course-lectures only lists lectures in the active semester, so lectures inserted without a semester don't appear there; use the existing April absent lectures to test that page.
